points.point: used to 肯定(过去常常/曾经,现已不然)

points.point: didn't use to 否定(use 不带 d)
points.overview: 否定 didn't use to + 动词原形。注意助动词 didn't 后 use 不带 d。

points.point: used to 疑问与反意疑问句
points.overview: 疑问 Did + 主语 + use to…?;陈述句 used to… 的反意疑问用 didn't + 主语(There used to be→didn't there)。
